package.name: drlabs_msgs
package.description: The records the DrLabs real-time runtime (`drlabs rt`) exchanges over CycloneDDS. A node using rmw_cyclonedds on the runtime's domain publishes LowCmd on /drlabs/lowcmd and subscribes to LowState on /drlabs/lowstate with these types and no bridge; the runtime hand-writes the same CDR the generated code produces (crates/drlabs-api/src/cdr.rs).
